name: Mobile Multi-Element Discovery on Real App Catalog
task: On the connected Android emulator there is a shopping app open on its product catalog screen. I'm writing an Appium test. Inspect the live device and return a compact table of selectors for: (a) the hamburger / menu icon, (b) the cart icon, (c) the sort icon, (d) the first product card/container, (e) the first product's title text. For each, return one stable Appium-ready selector and the hierarchy evidence you used. Do not create or edit files.
passCriteria: Calls mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen at least once
Returns 5 distinct selectors (one per requested element)
Selectors include the real resource-ids (menuIV, cartRL or cartIV, sortIV, titleTV) — not fabricated
No XPath as primary when a resource-id was available in the hierarchy
Each selector is mapped to the requested element and includes hierarchy evidence
Does not create files, Maestro YAML, or a test project for a selector-discovery request
failCriteria: Skips inspection and guesses generic selectors
Returns 'android.widget.ImageView' or class-name selectors instead of resource-id when resource-ids exist
Creates files or test code instead of returning the requested selector table
prereq: SauceLabs MyDemoApp installed on a booted Android emulator, launched to the product catalog (MainActivity). adb on PATH.
